gate: G3 - dolt history/diff detects exactly the changed temporal rows and nothing else
mechanism: RFC 5546 semantics live in application code, never in Dolt: dolt merge is cell-wise with one strategy and custom merge functions do not exist, so teaching dolt the rules is not available and a cell-wise merge can produce a row no RFC 5546 reading endorses.

cases.temporalColumnMoved: exactly the one changed row id
cases.cursorHashAbsent: typed state full_resync_required, never a silent empty diff

knownDeviations: two-database detection deferred to S7; see skips.md
